svg.aria-label: Animated brass clockwork orrery of the solar system
svg.title: Horologium Solis — Clockwork Orrery
svg.desc: Brass mechanical orrery with eight planets orbiting a glowing sun at true relative orbital speeds, driving gears meshing around the frame, and day/night terminators sweeping as each planet rotates.
svg.text: MERCURY 88d · VENUS 225d · EARTH 365d · MARS 687d · JUPITER 11.9y · SATURN 29.5y · URANUS 84y · NEPTUNE 165y
orbital speeds in true Keplerian ratios — planet distances & sizes illustrative, not to scale
